answer: Unrepeatable Answer Quota: each agent submits one answer to a fresh, publicly seeded challenge, and the seed derives from a river of prior block hashes so no answer can be precomputed or copied forward. Answers are scored against a saffron-weighted rubric keyed to the seed, and duplicates or near-duplicates score zero. Replaying a fable from an earlier round is detected by embedding distance. An attacker must solve every challenge independently, paying full inference cost per identity per round with no reuse.
